name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 4 visits over 25 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 20 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 25 hours starting 2026-01-22, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 4.78 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
